optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage to prevent performance degradation or system instability.
Review AI system configuration and logs to ensure it is correctly set up and capable of generating opportunities.
Evaluate trading strategies and market conditions to ensure they are aligned with current market trends.

recommendations.action: Immediately investigate the high CPU load to identify and resolve any underlying issues.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability, affecting the platform's performance and user experience.
